To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the effective implementation of KM processes and the support of top management for KM are important factors in achieving business value from KM.
KM process implementation is a key antecedent of business value and that top management support is positively related to KM process implementation, which is positively related to business.

(1) KM process effectiveness is significantly related to business value; (2) top management support and the organizational culture are positively related to KM effectiveness; (3) top management support is positively related to business values; (4) the organizational culture is positively related to KM process effectiveness; and (5) top management support of the organizational culture and KM effectiveness are significantly related to KM process implementation
In summary, our research is concerned with
the business value of knowledge management and the antecedents of business value.
how knowledge management (KM) creates business value.
the relationship between KM processes and the business value of these processes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the business value of a knowledge management initiative depends upon the effective implementation of the knowledge management processes, which are supported by top management and an organizational culture that is conducive to knowledge sharing.
knowledge management is a process, which involves a set of activities that are designed to create, capture, store, transfer, and apply organizational knowledge.
knowledge management is an effective tool that can be used to increase business value, and that this value is increased through the implementation of effective knowledge management processes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
knowledge management (KM) is a process that creates business value.

the business value of an organization's KM efforts is positively influenced by top management support of the KM effort, the effectiveness of the organization's KM process implementation, the organizational culture, and the perceived KM barriers.

the creation of business value through KM is not a trivial task. It requires the effective implementation of a number of KM processes, as well as top management support and an organizational culture that supports KM.
The main takeaway from our work is that

KM initiatives that create business values are important and that the business value of a KM initiative is a function of the effective implementation of KM processes and the top management support of the KM initiative.
KM is a complex phenomenon that can have a significant impact on business value when the right conditions are met.
organizations should be aware that there are multiple ways to create business value from knowledge management.
